transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, just some issues at work. Ever since I got that county safety award, certain people have been... twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking these pointed budget questions. It's like they're trying to make me look crooked. 

My supervisor says it's just a normal review, but... I don't know. I can tell there's a coordinated effort to discredit me. So... I'm just here about that.
Can you tell me more about how you know these people are coordinating against you? Have you noticed any specific actions or evidence that supports this?

Well... I mean, I just said. It's the reports. The way they keep bringing up those budget details now. It never used to happen before I got that award. 

I just... I know what I'm looking at. I don't really want to get into all the exact specifics right now, but... you can just tell they're working together on it. Even if my boss won't admit it.
Have you ever considered that these concerns might not be true, even after others have explained that there’s no clear evidence against you?

No... not really. I mean, I know what I see. 

I know they say there's no evidence, but... it's like I told you. Ever since I got that safety award, they've been messing with my reports. Asking all those budget questions. They want me to look crooked. 

My supervisor can call it a normal review all he wants, but... I know there's a coordinated effort to discredit me. I just know it.
Do you believe that others are against you even though they haven't given any clear signs or proof that this is true?

I... I feel like I just answered this. The signs are there. 

Like I said, it's the reports. Ever since that county safety award, they've been twisting them. Asking all those pointed budget questions to make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps brushing it off as a normal review, but... I'm not stupid. I can tell it's a coordinated effort to discredit me. 

I don't really know what else to tell you.
Have you ever experienced any strange sensations, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, especially when you're alone?
No. I don't... I don't have anything like that going on. I'm just trying to do my job.
Have you ever had any beliefs that others find unusual or hard to understand, even though you feel certain they are true?

I... I mean, I guess other people might find it hard to understand. But I've already told you what's happening. 

It's the reports. Ever since I got that safety award, they're... they're twisting things. Asking all those budget questions to make me look like I'm doing something wrong. My supervisor says it's just a normal review, but I know better. It's a coordinated effort to discredit me. I don't know why that's so hard for people to get.
Can you tell me if you have ever had any other beliefs that others might find strange or unusual, but you feel certain are true, even when there's no clear proof?
No. I don't... I don't have anything else. Just what I already told you.

Do you think these concerns about your reports and being discredited are the only things that have been bothering you, or have you noticed other things about your thinking or experiences that feel off or unusual to you?
I... no. Just the reports. There's nothing wrong with my thinking. I just want to do my job without them coming after me. That's... that's all it is.
Have you had any other thoughts or beliefs lately that you feel strongly about, even if others might not agree with you or find them odd?
No. Like I said, it's just the stuff at work. I don't have any other... weird thoughts. I'm just trying to deal with what they're doing to my reports. That's it.
